Shining Pearl}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Aaron/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Aaron anime.png|thumb|220px|Aaron in {{aniseries|DP}}]] [[File:Young Aaron.png|thumb|left|220px|Aaron when he was younger]] ====''Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl''==== Aaron was briefly mentioned by fellow [[Elite Four]] member [[Lucian]] in ''[[DP035|An Elite Meet and Greet!]]''. He then debuted in ''[[DP099|A Trainer and Child Reunion!]]'', where he was shown to be preparing for his championship {{pkmn|battle}} against {{an|Cynthia}}. He was conducting a public {{pkmn|training}} session at a small town between [[Hearthome City]] and [[Solaceon Town]], which had been advertised in an issue of the {{DL|Magazines in the Pokémon world|Poké Chic}} magazine that featured him on the cover. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} decided to go watch Aaron train and joined the long line of fans that were there to meet him, with {{an|Dawn}} getting her copy of Poké Chic signed by him. When Aaron found out that the group knew Cynthia personally, he invited them to his training center. There, he revealed that a {{p|Wurmple}} was his [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]] and close friend when he was young, but due to his anger at it for losing a match, he abandoned it. He regretted it later, and from then on, he tried his best to train hard and to understand {{type|Bug}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} so that the same incident would not happen again. Aaron eventually encountered Wurmple again as a {{TP|Aaron|Beautifly}} by the end of the episode, following a battle against {{TRT}}. Aaron reappeared in [[DP100|the next episode]], where he was seen on [[television]] having his battle with Cynthia at the {{DL|Pokémon League|Champion League}}, but he lost. ====[[Pokémon movie]]s==== Aaron made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ====Character==== Aaron likes to be surrounded by nature and {{type|Bug}} Pokémon. He tends to train in the forests, which allow him to rest up for upcoming challenges. He also enjoys the attention given by the status of being an [[Elite Four]] member. In addition, Aaron places [[friendship]] in high value, particularly with his Pokémon. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Aaron's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{trainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Aaron |pkmn=Beautifly |stage1=Wurmple |stage2=Silcoon |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Aaron Beautifly.png |epnum=DP099 |epname=A Trainer and Child Reunion! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Michele Knotz |desc=Aaron first encountered his {{p|Beautifly}} as a {{p|Wurmple}} when it helped him down from a high tree. They became very close friends, but finally Aaron became irritated that it always lost in {{pkmn|battle}} and abandoned it in a park. When he later returned to find Wurmple, it was gone. The same Wurmple returned in ''[[DP099|A Trainer and Child Reunion!]]'', where it was revealed to have since [[Evolution|evolved]] into a Beautifly. They reunited beside the very same tree where they had first met. It informed Aaron that it decided to start training by itself to become stronger. Beautifly then helped Aaron, {{Ash}}, and {{ashfr}} to battle {{TRT}} after they tried to steal Aaron's Pokémon. After this, Aaron took Beautifly back into his [[party|team]]. Beautifly reappeared in [[DP100|the next episode]], where Aaron used it as his last Pokémon in his battle against Cynthia. It went up against Cynthia's {{p|Gastrodon}}, but it was [[Fainting|knocked out]] by Gastrodon's powerful {{m|Stone Edge}}.}} {{trainerPoké |trainer=Aaron |pkmn=Skorupi |type1=Poison |type2=Bug |img=Aaron Skorupi.png |epnum=DP099 |epname=A Trainer and Child Reunion! |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |desc=Aaron was seen training with a {{p|Skorupi}} in the lead-up to his match against {{an|Cynthia}}. He is seen taking his Stunky to a Pokémon which {{PPM|Red}} and {{TP|Red|Clefairy}} becomes in charge of. He reads a book while waiting for Stunky to feel better. However, the treatment Clefairy gave it was ruined by Stunky falling into the treatment machine and this failure made Stunky's condition worse. Aaron didn't like what Clefairy did after finding out about this. After Stunky used {{m|Poison Gas}} on Red, his Pokémon, and {{PPM|Professor Oak}}, both Aaron and Stunky leave the Pokémon Center. ====Pokémon==== {{trainerPoké |width=74 |trainer=Aaron |pkmn=Stunky |type1=Poison |type2=Dark |img=Aaron Stunky PMDP.png |epnum=PMDP15 |epname=Clefairy's Pokémon Center is Super Useful!? |desc={{p|Stunky}} was injured during its debut in which Aaron takes it to a Pokémon Center in which {{PPM|Red}} and {{TP|Red|Clefairy}} were running at the time. {{TP|Red|Clefairy}} takes care of it by putting it down on a machine. Stunky accidentally falls inside which ruined the treatment and Stunky became worse than before. Aaron didn't like what Clefairy did and ran off with Stunky after Stunky used Poison Gas on Red, his Pokémon, and {{PPM|Professor Oak}}. Stunky's only known move is {{m|Poison Gas}}.}} {{-}} ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Aaron Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Aaron in Pokémon Adventures]] Aaron, along with Lucian and Bertha, appeared during the {{MangaArc|Platinum}}, having been enlisted by the [[Pokémon Association]] to decipher [[Charon]]'s notebook that was stolen by {{adv|Diamond}}'s {{p|Lickilicky}}, [[Kit]].
